result.text: Cohort 4 (previously treated): ORR 40.6% (95% CI 28.9, 53.1), median DOR 9.72 months (95% CI 5.55, 12.98). Cohort 5b (treatment-naïve): ORR 67.9% (95% CI 47.6, 84.1), median DOR 11.14 months (95% CI 5.55, NE).

citations.quote: The primary objective, ORR per BIRC, was met in subjects with MET-mutated NSCLC, irrespective of the line of treatment. target_moa.text: Capmatinib is an orally bioavailable, ATP-competitive kinase inhibitor that targets the MET receptor tyrosine kinase, including the mutated variant produced by MET exon 14 skipping.

Serious adverse reactions in \ge 2\% of patients included dyspnea (7%), pneumonia (4.8%), pleural effusion (3.6%), general physical health deterioration (3%), vomiting (2.4%), and nausea (2.1%). A fatal adverse reaction occurred in one patient (0.3%) due to pneumonitis.
ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 4.5% of patients treated with TABRECTA in GEOMETRY mono-1, with 1.8% of patients experiencing Grade 3 ILD/pneumonitis and one patient experiencing death (0.3%).
